title: geo.map_config
description: The basemap and location-picker configuration a map needs before its first frame: tile URL template, the attribution the ODbL licence obliges the map to display, the zoom envelope, the product's operating bbox, and the search-as-you-type discipline. Same payload as GET /geo/api/v1/map/config, for server-rendered hosts. Takes no arguments; touches neither the database nor the network.
